purpose: Reusable technical knowledge for GIA and every specialist agent. This is additive merge-only memory; it does not replace project-scoped memory.

rules.tenant_isolation: Project-scoped memory must never be returned across users/projects.

projects.name: GIA Universal AI / Universal AI Commander
knowledge: GIA is the universal commander, not merely a worker agent.
Unified experience combines natural conversation, software building, agent orchestration, sandbox execution, verification, memory/RAG, checkpoints, rollback, and controlled deployment.
Primary reliable v1 target is authenticated CRUD SaaS using React/TypeScript, FastAPI, and MongoDB.
Architecture emphasizes project isolation, governed tools, model routing, deterministic tools, evidence-gated verification, and approval gates.
Credit optimization requires targeted retrieval, summaries, diffs, caching, routing, deterministic operations, and bounded retries.
Voice is pluggable and must not claim completion without backend evidence.

projects.name: HRGen AI Studio / GIA AI Studio
knowledge: Existing concepts include AI-first workspace, AI agents, website builder, CMS, deployment, CRM, SEO, plugin/connectors, event bus, agent memory, task queue, CEO orchestration.
Agent workforce previously included CEO, Project Manager, UI/UX, Website Builder, SEO, Content, Marketing, CRM, Deploy, QA/Test, Research, Analytics.
Connector and provider abstractions are reusable architectural references.

projects.name: GIA AI Money Finder / Intelligence + Build Engine
knowledge: Reusable intelligence concepts: multi-source discovery, compliant source routing/fallback, normalization/deduplication, AI opportunity scoring, competitor intelligence, UI and automation.
Source access must remain compliant and respect provider rules.

projects.name: Universal AI Computer & Project Manager
knowledge: Managed vault, versioning, experiments versus validated/released separation, testing/evidence, preview/impact analysis, minimal human approvals, free-first resource selection, PC/VPS/phone management, and escalation for unresolved live incidents.
These are governance patterns to reuse, not a competing runtime.

projects.name: HRGen AI Workforce / Deploy
knowledge: PowerShell/FTP deployment workflow concepts, agent workforce orchestration, queue/discovery/eventBus patterns, and configurable LLM provider routing are reusable.
Existing provider strategy included cheap/fast routing and escalation rather than using premium models for every operation.

global_agent_skills.description: Inspect structure, identify KEEP/UPGRADE/MERGE/ADD/REMOVE candidates, preserve working functionality.
Convert natural language into an explicit specification and approval checkpoint.
Select only the specialist agents required for a task.
Build responsive React/TypeScript interfaces and live workspace UX.
Build FastAPI services, APIs, auth, queues, orchestration and integrations.
Design MongoDB schemas and migration-safe changes.
Run only permitted commands with bounded resources and audit evidence.
Build, test, diagnose failures, repair, regression test, and report evidence.
Apply isolation, permissions, secrets controls, approval gates and audit trails.
Retrieve only relevant, authorized project/global technical knowledge.
Use cheap models for routine work and escalate only on complexity/risk/failure.
Controlled export/deployment with approvals, version tracking and rollback.
Research, normalize, score and synthesize evidence using compliant sources.
Measure usage, failures, performance and product metrics.
Checkpoint, rollback, preserve last known-good state and recover safely.

global_decisions: No competing runtime should replace GIA; legacy projects are treated as reusable knowledge/components.
No fake functionality or unverified success claims.
Locked blueprint remains authoritative; memory is additive and cannot silently modify governance.
Technical project memory should be reusable across agents while project/user isolation remains enforced.
